purpose: Teach: あらわす/すすめる/雇う/建つ/散る/知ろ/ずばり/いちど

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは想いを書道であらわす方だったぞ
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he used to express his feelings through calligraphy.
lines.style: Soft, remembering gaze. Weight on each memory. Slow, deliberate pacing. Voice carries affection — not bright, but deeply settled, like touching something precious.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、孫に本をすすめるのが楽しみだったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — and he loved recommending books to his grandchildren, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm, conversational, gently affirming. Slight upturn at the end — she's inviting him into the memory, not reciting it. Breath and presence, like sitting beside him.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは多くの社員を雇うご決断をされたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he made the big decision to hire many people for his company.
lines.style: Same measured cadence as before. The pride is quiet — he's not boasting, he's witnessing. Slight pause between phrases, like turning pages in a book.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、新築の家が建つのを楽しみにしていらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And he looked forward to seeing that new house built, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Nodding along, her voice bright with shared knowing. A little lift of affection on 'didn't he' — she's checking in with him, making sure the memory lands.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんと桜の散る道を歩いたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, I walked with him down a path where the cherry blossoms were falling.
lines.style: Quieter now, almost intimate. The memory is fragile, precious. Breath soft. Lingering slightly on 'falling' — the moment suspended.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、新しい技術も知ろうとなさってたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And he was always trying to learn about new things, wasn't he, dear?
lines.style: Gentle agreement, steady as before. Her voice carries the ease of long companionship. Not performing — just being there, confirming what matters.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、お父さんはずばり物事を言う方だったぞ
lines.en: Gran, your father — he was the kind of man who said things straight.
lines.style: A touch firmer, more present. Not harsh — conviction in the plainness. He's pointing to something true about him. Eyes still soft, but voice has shape.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、いちど、ばあさんと旅行に行きたいねって仰ったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And do you remember how he once said he wanted to take me on a trip, dear?
lines.style: Closest now, almost whispering. This memory is hers, and she's giving it to him. Her voice holds both tenderness and the ache of something unrealized. Trailing off gently at 'dear.'
